ITEM 1 | Two elongated strips, dark reddish-brown with a glossy, slightly oily sheen, scalloped/wavy edges, firm and holding shape, browned surface with some darker charred-looking patches, lying diagonally across a white rectangular-rounded plate; the longer strip is about 13 cm by 3 cm and the shorter about 10 cm by 2.5 cm, together covering roughly 15% of the plate | 45

ITEM 2 | Small clumps of pale yellow, soft, crumbly-looking material with a slightly glossy texture, scattered in three spots on top of and between the reddish strips, each clump about 1 cm across and under 0.5 cm high | 6
